text:
Dentro of the mortaja of esta house

in esta night yerma with tanta soledad,

mirando without nostalgia lo that in my life is ido,

lo that no pudo ser,

esta ruina extensa of the pasado,

also without esperanza

in lo that ha of venir aún a flagelarme,

only is posible a bien: the aparición of the ángel,

his eyes vivos, no sé of what color, but of fire,

the paralización ante the rostro hermosísimo.

Después to hear, saliendo of the silencio and in tanta soledad,

his voz without traducción, that is only a fiel entendimiento without words.

And the ángel hace, cerrándose in mis párpados and cobijado in ellos, his

aparición postrera:

with his espada of fire expulsa the mundo hostil, that gira afuera,

a oscuras.

And no there is Dios to él, ni to mí.

translation.title: Dentro of the mortaja of esta house...
